fields.order: Number of vertices in the source graph.
fields.broken_witnesses: Counts of sampled forbidden-cycle witnesses broken by a proposal.
fields.removed_load: Source-graph load carried by edges removed by a proposal.
fields.new_edge_distance: Mean source-graph distance between endpoints of proposed new edges.
fields.local_risk: Bounded local triangle/square closure risk before authoritative scoring.
fields.remaining_steps: Search budget remaining after the current proposal pool is built.
fields.stagnation: Consecutive accepted steps without a strict objective improvement.

authority: These are deterministic source-graph proxies, not oracle scores.
